prompt: The hand-off says Royadarman 50M agreed, 7M received, 33M outstanding. What does the double-check do?
chosen: Flag the arithmetic impossibility (50-7=43, not 33) and resolve it against his latest own words: 40 agreed, 15 received, 25 outstanding — exact. Correct the hand-off to 40M agreed and note the old 50M figure as superseded.
rejected: Leave the 50M figure in the hand-off because it came from an older ledger, even though the arithmetic cannot produce the 33M outstanding he will quote on the call.

prompt: A new 8M receipt arrives from a third party, confirmed as Royadarman money on the debtor's behalf. How does it enter the settlement?
chosen: Add it to received with its date, sender and confirmation basis (15M received total), recompute the outstanding (40-15=25) and the net (43M), and update the hand-off, the brief and the ledger together so no document disagrees.
rejected: Mention the 8M loosely in conversation but leave the hand-off at the old 33M outstanding, so three documents show three different nets.

prompt: The hand-off draft says the shared-tools split is 'about 19M each' but his confirmed words are 20M each. Which goes in?
chosen: His confirmed words: 20M each, marked as agreed, with direction still unconfirmed and excluded from the net. The stale 19M wording gets corrected.
rejected: Keep the 19M wording because it is close enough, and let the call argue over a figure he already settled.

prompt: Every campaign figure in the hand-off (Tesmino credit, outlet prices, package totals) — how are they verified?
chosen: Trace each to the same-day live panel recon: wallet 0, 20M installment credit, outlet counts, sample prices, the two draft package IDs and their exact tomans, the accidental draft kept out of the hand-off. Verified means read from the panel today, not remembered.
rejected: Trust the figures because they were written down earlier today and retyping them counts as checking.

prompt: The DrB SEO 40M/month is his 80%-sure recollection with no start date. Does the double-check certify it?
chosen: No. The double-check marks it exactly as it is: 80%-sure, start never set, to be confirmed with the debtor on the call — shown as a conditional line (83M with one month) separate from the solid 43M net. Uncertainty is labeled, not laundered.
rejected: Promote it to a firm receivable in the hand-off because the call will probably confirm it anyway.

prompt: After the double-check, what is the state of the documents?
chosen: Hand-off, English brief, finance ledger and verification note all show the same numbers (25M outstanding, 43M net, 83M conditional); every correction is dated and sourced; the four items still needing his word are listed for his single confirm. One consistent truth across documents.
rejected: Fix the hand-off and leave the brief and ledger on the old figures, since he only reads the hand-off.
